title: Shared feature views and common-mode misses in malware detection: clean-run protocol
status_of_evaluation_data: The official .NET and Win64 test weeks (53-64) were examined once each in the original SENTRA project (timestamps in PROVENANCE.md). This clean run is a reproduction of those evaluations with complete deduplicated cohorts; it is not a blind confirmation.

windows.week_definition: Training-archive member k (sorted by name) is week k; test-archive member k is week 52 + k. Verified against member date ranges, first_submission_date and week_id.

cohorts.sampling: none: all unique files in each window are used
cohorts.deduplication: exact SHA256 records collapsed to their first occurrence in chronological member order; test files whose SHA256 occurs anywhere in the training archive (weeks 1-52) are excluded
cohorts.labels: label field in {0, 1}; any other value excluded and counted
cohorts.family: ClarAVy family field; missing values retained and treated as singleton clusters in the bootstrap

features.preprocessing: signed log1p, then z-score with training-row statistics, columns with training std <= 1e-6 removed, values clipped to [-20, 20]; fitted on training rows only, per file type
features.storage_dtype: float16 for preprocessed arrays (computation in float32)

model.architecture: two independent MLP branches (input -> 64 -> ReLU -> 32 -> ReLU -> 1); branch S reads the structural view, branch C the content view
model.loss: sum of the two branch binary cross-entropies with positive-class weight n_benign / n_malware (the branches share no parameters, so their gradients are independent)
model.optimiser: Adam, learning rate 1e-3, weight decay 1e-5, batch size 512
model.early_stopping: patience 5 on validation OR-system TPR at 1% system FPR with jointly optimised thresholds (51-point grid); weights of the best epoch restored
model.batch_order: torch.randperm with generator seed = 1000 * seed + epoch

calibration.rule: threshold = floor(0.005 * N_benign)-th largest validation benign score; decision score > threshold (ties never flagged)

endpoints.primary: mean over seed pairs of [mean excess(SS, CC) - mean excess(SC, CS)] in percentage points, excess = J - q1*q2 computed per pairing on test malware
secondary: realised OR-system FPR on test benign files

inference.method: paired family-cluster bootstrap over test malware; the same resampled files enter every pairing; q1, q2 and J recomputed in each replicate; seed pairs averaged inside each replicate

decision_rule.supported: estimate >= 2 pp and 95% interval entirely above 0

scope: Error dependence at fixed branch thresholds. No detection-superiority claim is made without an equal-system-FPR comparison.
